additional_info.body: As I don´t have access to router forwarding this to L3.

additional_info.subject: NOTE FROM L3
additional_info.body:
Topic to be raised in Product Care. Workaround is tested and working with small hiccups
Workaround:
1. Upload v7.06.3 to Router in /tmp folder
2. sysupgrade -F -c RUT2M_R_00.07.06.3_WEBUI.bin
3. change LAN IP address manually to 10.20.17.1/2
4. via SSH do: echo -e "admin01\nadmin01\n" | passwd && echo -e "admin01\nadmin01\n" | passwd admin
5. Reboot
